summary: Verified iteration_6 scope: Broadcasts PATCH/DELETE, Invoices PATCH/DELETE, Sub-charter DELETE. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass; frontend flows (CRM Broadcast edit+delete, Finance Invoice edit+delete, Partners Sub-charter delete) all functional with correct toasts and row updates. One discrepancy noted vs spec: marketing_admin is allowed on /api/broadcasts (200) per permissions_config.py (crm section includes marketing_admin) — spec expected 403.

minor.issue: Spec expected marketing_admin to receive 403 on /api/broadcasts, but permissions_config.py grants marketing_admin access to section 'crm'. Actual response is 200. Either update spec expectation or restrict crm section (remove marketing_admin) if broadcasts should be owner/ops-only.

action_items: Clarify RBAC intent for broadcasts: current code allows marketing_admin (grants 200); if you truly want 403 for marketing_admin as per spec, remove 'marketing_admin' from CRM section or gate broadcasts with require_role('owner','ops_admin').
critical_code_review_comments: Broadcast delete allows deleting a 'sending' broadcast? No — routers/broadcasts.py explicitly blocks status 'sending' with 400. Good.
Invoice delete correctly restricts to draft/void; PATCH amount blocked after paid/void; status whitelist enforced. Solid.
Sub-charter delete rejects confirmed/settled properly; cancel-then-delete path works.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted transient TEST_ broadcasts, invoices, and subcharters (sbc SC-0010) during tests; all cleaned up.
